segments.name: Consumer Floral & Gifts
segments.description: Sells fresh flowers, plants, fruit arrangements and personalized gifts directly to consumers through its flagship floral and gifting brands.
segments.evidence: The Consumer Floral & Gifts segment includes the operations of the Company's flagship brand, 1-800-Flowers.com, Personalization Mall, Things Remembered, FruitBouquets.com, and Flowerama, while the Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets segment includes the operations of Harry & David, Wolferman's Bakery, Vital Choice, Moose Munch, Cheryl's Cookies, Mrs. Beasley's, The Popcorn Factory, DesignPac, 1-800-Baskets.com, Simply Chocolate, Shari's Berries, and Scharffen Berger.

segments.name: BloomNet
segments.description: Provides products, services and wholesale floral supplies that help professional florists and retail flower shops grow their businesses.
segments.evidence: The BloomNet segment includes the operations of BloomNet, Napco, and Card Isle.

segments.name: Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets
segments.description: Sells premium fruit, gourmet foods, cookies, popcorn, chocolate and gift baskets to consumers and wholesale customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in the following three business segments: Consumer Floral & Gifts, Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets, and BloomNet.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for merchandise, services and outbound shipping charges, with revenue reduced by discounts, returns and credits.
revenueModel.evidence: Net revenues consist primarily of the selling price of the merchandise, service and outbound shipping charges, less discounts, returns and credits.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company acquired Card Isle, adding greeting cards and its operations to the BloomNet segment.
changes.evidence: On April 3, 2024, the Company completed its acquisition of Card Isle, an e-commerce greeting card company, expanding the Company's presence in the greeting card category across its brands.

changes.text: The 2024 Scharffen Berger acquisition expanded the product offerings of the Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets segment.
changes.evidence: On July 1, 2024, the Company completed its acquisition of certain assets of Scharffen Berger®, a manufacturer of giftable premium chocolate and specialty treats, expanding the Company's product offerings in the Gourmet Foods & Gift Baskets segment.
